title: auth.message.requested payload
description: Auth's copy of the shared transactional-message payload (ADR-0030). `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog by file name and `RoutingKey` refuses a wildcard, so `*.message.requested` cannot be a file name — each emitting service ships its own copy under its own routing key, and this is Auth's.

user_id.description: Set when the recipient already has an account.

data.description: Variables the template renders. Never a password.

idempotency_key.description: From the business fact that caused the message (`auth.invitation:1842`), never random — a redelivered event must not send a second mail.
